title: A Signal for the Machine
author: Petra Almeida
blurb: Jonah Zhou, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
